slogan: Give blood, spread cheer, save a life, show you care.
heroBody: A social and voluntary organization established in 2018 in Ashuganj, Brahmanbaria, Bangladesh.
aboutBody: Fotabo Hashi is a social and voluntary organization established in 2018 in Ashuganj, Brahmanbaria. Guided by humanitarian values and social responsibility, we promote voluntary blood donation and connect donors with people in urgent need. Through blood donation campaigns, support for disadvantaged people, and humanitarian initiatives, we strive to stand beside those in need. We believe one willing blood donor can save a life, and collective efforts can bring smiles to countless faces.
missionBody: To promote voluntary blood donation, connect donors with people in need, and support disadvantaged communities.
visionBody: To build a compassionate, equitable society where people can find support when blood is urgently needed.
valuesBody: Humanity, Compassion, Volunteerism, Integrity, Social Responsibility, Unity & Cooperation.
ourWorkBody: We connect willing blood donors with people in urgent need and support our community through humanitarian initiatives.
